description: Frontend Interview History Page - Paginated list of all user's interviews with filtering by status and navigation to reports or active interview rooms. Shows interview metadata in table/card format with search and sort capabilities.
steps: Import: useState, useEffect, useRouter from next/navigation, api, Navbar, icons from lucide-react (Calendar, Briefcase, Target, TrendingUp, Clock, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Filter)
State: interviews (array), page (number, default 1), limit (number, default 10), totalPages (number), statusFilter (string, default null), loading (boolean), error (string)

useEffect on [page, statusFilter]: build query params, GET /interviews?page={page}&limit={limit}&status={statusFilter}, destructure { interviews, total, page, totalPages } from response, setInterviews and setTotalPages, handle errors
Display options: table view for desktop (responsive), card grid for mobile

Table columns: Date (format createdAt as 'MMM DD, YYYY'), Job Role (jobRole.title), Type (badge with color: HR=purple, TECHNICAL=blue, PROJECT=green), Difficulty (badge: EASY=green, MEDIUM=yellow, HARD=red), Status (badge: CREATED=gray, IN_PROGRESS=blue, COMPLETED=green), Score (show overallScore/100 if COMPLETED, else '-')

Row interaction: onClick handler checks status, if COMPLETED navigate to /interview/{id}/report, if IN_PROGRESS navigate to /interview/{id}, if CREATED show toast 'Start this interview first' and don't navigate
Filter controls: dropdown or radio group above table with options: All Interviews, Created, In Progress, Completed. onChange updates statusFilter and resets page to 1
Pagination controls: Previous button (disabled if page===1), page indicator 'Page {page} of {totalPages}', Next button (disabled if page===totalPages). Buttons trigger setPage

Empty state: if interviews.length===0 and !loading show card with icon, heading 'No Interviews Yet', description 'Start your first AI mock interview to see it here.', button 'Start Interview' linking to /interview/setup
Loading state: show skeleton table/cards with shimmer effect
Error state: show error alert with retry button
Statistics summary at top: total interviews count, average score (calculate from completed interviews), completion rate (completed / total * 100%)
Styling: match dashboard aesthetic, responsive design, hover effects on rows, smooth transitions
Layout: Navbar + main with max-w-7xl container
acceptance_criteria: History page fetches and displays paginated interviews
Table/cards show all relevant interview metadata
Status filter updates the list and resets to page 1
Pagination controls navigate between pages correctly
Clicking COMPLETED interview navigates to report page
Clicking IN_PROGRESS interview navigates to interview room
Empty state displays when user has no interviews
Loading and error states handled gracefully
Statistics summary calculates correctly from interview data
Page is fully responsive (table on desktop, cards on mobile)
verification: Verify interviews list displays with correct data
Test status filter: select 'Completed', verify only completed interviews show
Test pagination: if > 10 interviews, verify Next/Previous buttons work
Click on a completed interview row, verify navigation to report
Create new interview and leave it in CREATED status, verify clicking shows toast and doesn't navigate
Test empty state: filter for status that has no interviews, verify empty state displays
Test responsive: resize browser to mobile width, verify card layout appears
